name: jarque.bera.test
title: Skewness and kurtosis use the divisor n. The p-value is the chi-square tail on 2 degrees of freedom.

arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Skewness and kurtosis use the divisor n. The p-value is the chi-square tail on 2 degrees of freedom.

origin.example:
set.seed(11)
j <- jarque.bera.test(rnorm(50))
paste(cell(j$statistic), cell(j$p.value), sep = "|")
